about: The one upstream file a Domovoi room stick starts from (domovoi/usb_stick/): Debian's official amd64
netinst image, downloaded by the household's own server from Debian and used only if its size and
SHA-256 are these. Debian's files on the stick are left as they are; only Domovoi's own files are added.
Moving the pin: fetch SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sign from the release's iso-cd folder, check them with
gpgv against debian-role-keys.gpg (Debian CD signing key DF9B9C49EAA9298432589D76DA87E80D6294BE9B),
read the new image's size and SHA-256, check its shim's signatures (sbverify --list /EFI/boot/bootx64.efi:
a shim signed only with Microsoft's 2023 certificate does not start on PCs whose firmware only trusts
the 2011 one), and run the QEMU matrix (docs/SPARE_DEVICE_SATELLITES.md, Old computer).
name: debian-13.7.0-amd64-netinst.iso
signed_sums: SHA256SUMS + SHA256SUMS.sign, good signature from the Debian CD signing key (DF9B9C49EAA9298432589D76DA87E80D6294BE9B), checked 2026-10-15
